name: Cindervale Magmaweave Thread
description: A heatproof thread spun from lava-cured fiber.
specialEffects: Used in magma harnesses, emberbound armor, and fireproof stitchwork.

steps: Refine raw stock for Cindervale Magmaweave Thread under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Cindervale Refinery protocol before storage.
